description: Manual identity registry from corpus mentions, not benchmark answers. Groups apply only to listed source documents and cases with matching named anchors. Amounts, crimes and sentences are always extracted from sources.

case_groups.evidence: The articles identify Duong Minh Tuan as Hoang Nato, and describe the arrest and investigation with Phan Kim Nhi in the same HCMC operation. Other subcases without these anchors are not grouped.
Both articles describe the same institute case with 65 defendants, Le Van Dong and the Sam Son drug party; the second reports the continuing trial.
